title: Project Atom in Serpo matches TTSA's Atom project

tellings.quote: And Project Atom is a um Los Alamos uh secret program that studies nuclear radiation and the radiation properties of materials recovered from extraterrestrial or alien spacecraft.

plain: A researcher, Deep Prasad, points to Project Serpo, a set of leaked papers that claim the US swapped people with an alien planet, and its mention of something called Project Atom. He describes Project Atom as a secret program at Los Alamos, the US nuclear laboratory in New Mexico, that studies the radiation of materials taken from alien spacecraft, and he links it to a project of the same name in the mid-2010s at To The Stars Academy, a private UFO research company tied to Tom DeLonge and a physicist named Hal Puthoff. If the match holds, it would suggest the leaked papers and the later company drew on the same hidden source.
